groups.why: Checks the AS From Site active/inactive state and Measure candidates by Sales Site type for Div 81. The expected results include AS From Site activity, which no other row checks, so it stays alone.
Checks whether SCM_FCST and MKT_FCST can be edited by Div, permission and SCP editing time window. This is an edit-permission check during a time window, not a candidate list, so it stays alone.

Checks the FCST Type combo and the input Measure limit by Site type together for Div 82. Its target and condition (Div 82, two elements) differ from V-c86a9779, which checks only the FCST Type candidates, so it stays alone.
Checks that the Measure Setting popup candidates are re-queried by Division right after screen entry, before Search. Both the target (popup) and the state (before Search) are unique.

Checks the input Measure controls (including AS_In_Req permission and VMI_In_Req VMI=Y) and the AS From Site combo for the Current version. Its target and expected results cover more than V-c4caff15, so it stays alone.
Checks only that the typo Measure "Cutomer FCST" is removed from the candidates and the data. No other row has this expected result.
Checks how the new-row Sales Site, Project popup, Model candidates and Team column behave. The target elements differ from every other row.
Checks the Measure display makeup by Div UI Category. It differs from the new-row Measure combo candidates (V-c4caff15) in both state and criteria, so it stays alone.
Checks that Groups registered in REQ_NO_DISPLAY are hidden from the permission request Group list. The target element is entirely separate.
Checks the new-row Measure combo candidates by Div and Sales Site type. The other Measure rows differ in their conditions (Current version, permission, AS From Site), so it stays alone.
Checks the new-row FCST Type candidates and candidate count by Div and permission group, based on SALES_TYPE_CODE. V-1cacf2b9 has a different Div and also covers Measure, so this stays alone.
Checks that the End Customer combo candidates on a Div 81 new row come only from the END_CUSTOMER lookup. No other row targets the same column.
